item.title: Claude Code with Local Backends: Install, Config, Ollama, and llama.cpp
item.description: Claude Code isn’t autocomplete with better marketing — it’s a terminal-native junior engineer that needs review. This guide covers install, settings layering, self-hosted Ollama and llama.cpp backends, pricing rails, and troubleshooting.
